settings.title: Viessmann developer account
settings.subtitle: Viessmann Client ID
settings.bodytext: Viessmann's free API plan requires every user to create their own Client ID. It takes about five minutes:

steps.portal: Open the Viessmann developer portal and sign in with your ViCare account (the same email address and password as in the ViCare app):
steps.client: Add a new client and give it a name, for example Homey.
steps.recaptcha: Turn Google reCAPTCHA off for the client. Logging in from Homey does not work while it is on.
steps.redirect: Set the redirect URI to exactly this address, with nothing added or missing:
steps.client_id: Save the client in the portal, copy its Client ID, paste it in the field below and press Save.
steps.pair: Add a new device in Homey, choose Viessmann ViCare and log in with your ViCare account.

settings.saved: Client ID saved successfully! You can now add your Viessmann device in Homey.

error.invalid_client_id: Please enter a valid Client ID

problems.title: Common problems

redirect.title: "Invalid redirection URI" on the Viessmann login page
redirect.fix: The redirect URI in your Viessmann client is not exactly right. Open the client in the developer portal, paste the redirect URI from step 4 again, save it and start adding the device again.

no_devices.title: Login works, but no devices are found or an unknown error appears
no_devices.fix: Check that your heating system shows up and is online in the ViCare app. Make sure the Client ID above was saved before you started adding the device. If you saved or changed it just now, close the window for adding devices and start again.

no_oauth2_client.title: "No OAuth2 Client Found" in the troubleshooting tools
no_oauth2_client.fix: The troubleshooting tools below use the login of an added device. Add a Viessmann ViCare device first, then try again.

reauth.title: Device unavailable after weeks or months ("Authentication failed" or connection lost)
reauth.fix: Short Viessmann outages fix themselves. If the device stays unavailable, your Viessmann login has probably expired, for example after a password change. Open the device, go to its settings, choose Repair and log in with your ViCare account again.

problems.report: Still stuck? Open the Viessmann ViCare app in Homey, send a diagnostic report and briefly describe what you did and what you saw.

troubleshooting.title: Troubleshooting
troubleshooting.description: These tools show the raw data the app gets from Viessmann, which helps the developer when something does not work. They need at least one added device. The data can contain serial numbers, so check it before you post it publicly.

installations.title: Installation Information
installations.description: Shows details about your Viessmann installation and connected devices

features.title: Device Features
features.description: Shows available features and current values for your device

device.title: Device Selection
device.description: Select which device to get features for

pair.no_client_id: No Viessmann Client ID has been saved yet. Open the settings of the Viessmann ViCare app, follow the steps there to create and save a Client ID, then add the device again.
